_metadata.title: Cluevoyance Unlimited guest beta: 50-word shortlist
_metadata.source: data/unlimited/wordbank-export-2026-10-15.json (complete live word bank, 1,196 words). Every word below is in that export.
_metadata.selection: Chosen by the Claude session for fun, familiarity, versatility and multiple everyday senses, in the spirit of party word games. Inspiration only; this is not any published game's list.
notes: ENGINE and MIRROR from the 20-word pilot were left out: the pilot found them dry and narrow.
The 18 retained pilot words carry 153 already-clued pairs with independent review scores (pilot-reuse).
Owner decision 2026-10-17: there is no board-level semantic review. The only cross-clue rule is four distinct hint texts per puzzle.
